1.text: Indirimbo ya Dawidi y'Amazamuka.Dorere, erega ni byiza n'iby'igikundiro,Ko abavandimwe baturana bahuje!

2.text: Bimeze nk'amavuta y'igiciro cyinshi yasutswe ku mutwe,Agatembera mu bwanwa,Mu bwanwa bwa Aroni,Agatembera ku misozo y'imyenda ye.

3.text: Kandi bimeze nk'ikime cyo kuri Herumoni,Kimanukira ku misozi y'i Siyoni,Kuko aho ari ho Uwiteka yategekeye umugisha,Ari wo bugingo bw'iteka ryose.
